say:2:1311265001:0.text: You are not the real Princess Yolena...
say:2:1311265001:0.source_cn: 你……你不是真正的亚莲娜公主。

say:4:1311265003:0.text: Who are you and what do you really want?!
say:4:1311265003:0.source_cn: 你到底是什么人！你想要干什么？

say:5:1311265004:0.text: General Valka, how is it possible that you don't know who I am? It's fine if they don't recognize me, but you... you should have me etched in your memory!
say:5:1311265004:0.source_cn: 瓦丽卡将军，你怎么会不知道我是谁呢？他们可以不知道，但...

say:6:1311265005:0.text: H-how do you know my name?!

say:11:1311265008:0.text: Wrong. I for certain am not the Great Will. The mighty and only true god is beyond what I can ever aspire to.

say:12:1311265009:0.text: I don't have any grand ideals; I'm just a simple Hypogean who delights in playing with snow and emotions.

say:13:1311265012:0.text: So, did you like my little scheme? A festival that repeats over and over must be quite enjoyable, don't you think?
say:13:1311265012:0.source_cn: 不断重复的祭典很好玩吧，是不是？这可是我一手策划和实现的哦。

say:14:1311265013:0.text: Oh, I can't tell you how much I love this festival. I want to experience it again and again...
say:14:1311265013:0.source_cn: 我真是太喜欢这个祭典了，喜欢到想要一次、一次、又一次地...

say:15:1311265014:0.text: After all, attending the Snowspire Festival was Yolena's final wish.
say:15:1311265014:0.source_cn: 毕竟“想再参加一次冬日祭典”，是我——不，是亚莲娜临终...

say:16:1311265015:0.text: Oh, that poor little girl. She was so pitiful, so I helped her—and her father.
say:16:1311265015:0.source_cn: 她好可怜，所以我帮了她，还有她的父亲。

say:17:1311265016:0.text: Now, everyone gets to have their wishes fulfilled. Isn't that the most impeccable fairy tale ending?
say:17:1311265016:0.source_cn: 现在，所有人都得偿所愿，这不是最圆满的童话结局吗？

say:23:1311265019:0.text: Oh, you charming yet ignorant little familiar, didn't your magister teach you anything about magic?
say:23:1311265019:0.source_cn: 哦，你这无知又可爱的小使魔，你的主人没有好好教你魔法知识吗？

say:27:1311265022:0.source_cn: 呵，小使魔，听好了，我可没有“害死”她，相反，是我让她...

say:28:1311265023:0.text: My "dear father" offered his life and soul to bring "me" back to life, and I kept my promises.
say:28:1311265023:0.source_cn: 这可是我“亲爱的父亲”献祭了自己的生命和灵魂所换来的愿...

say:29:1311265024:0.text: I understand now... You exploited Yolena's body; she never truly returned. It's always been you in disguise!
say:29:1311265024:0.source_cn: 我明白了……你只是利用了亚莲娜的身体，她从来没有再次复...

say:30:1311265025:0.text: That's not entirely true. Of course Yolena is back. I just infused her with my soul.
say:30:1311265025:0.source_cn: 是吗？可亚莲娜确实复活了啊，我把我的灵魂放进了她的躯体里。

say:31:1311265026:0.text: My beloved father is overjoyed that his daughter has returned, just as he remembers her—vibrant and full of life.
say:31:1311265026:0.source_cn: 我亲爱的父亲，他很高兴、很满足。我这位重新活过来的、可...

say:32:1311265027:0.text: And of course, his life and soul also bring me great joy.
say:32:1311265027:0.source_cn: 当然啦，他的生命和灵魂也让我很高兴、很满足。

say:34:1311265029:0.text: Call me whatever you like. I waited two thousand years for this glorious moment...

say:35:1311265030:0.source_cn: 喔，梅林，有你来见证我的重新诞生，我真的很高兴。
